author_reading.rationale: Same-clock register and output path. No cross-domain functional intent is needed for this control. clk_b is declared but unused.

rationale: SDC assigns d and out to clk_a; q captures on clk_a. clk_b is unused. Thus the entire visible data path is same-domain, with no data CDC or unknown external data clock. This is a valid structural data-CDC whole-IP noise control within the supplied configuration, not evidence of reset or ordinary timing closure. Physical synchronizer implementation and asynchronous reset release/recovery remain external obligations; neither SDC nor sampled digital simulation closes them.

labels.rationale: Input d, q and the output contract are all clk_a. The declared asynchronous clk_b is unused, so there is no data CDC in the shown design. Asynchronous reset release remains an orthogonal integration obligation.

Input d, register q and output out all belong to clk_a under the supplied SDC. The unused clk_b creates no data crossing. This is a structural same-domain result; ordinary timing closure and asynchronous reset release are orthogonal obligations.
